content: He who is content with what he has is already the richest man in the province.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Zhi zu zhe chang le (知足者常乐) — Laozi & Classical Folk Lore
explanation: Wealth is not a number in a ledger; it is the ratio between what you have and what you crave. The billionaire driven by unquenchable greed is an impoverished beggar chained to fear, while the humble artisan with a peaceful heart and satisfied mind lives in sovereign luxury.
practicalInsight: Look around your home right now and deliberately declare, 'I have enough.' Feel the immediate weight lifted from your shoulders.
reflectionPrompt: What are you relentlessly striving to acquire, believing it will finally bring the contentment that only a grateful heart can offer?
